snippet.title: Angry Dumpling — meet the PingBlip creatures. #Shorts
snippet.description:
Get your pet — free. Open @PingBlip and tap the game link in our profile.
No sign-up. Your first creature is a surprise; the creatures shown are examples.

Angry Dumpling — hatched from today's real weather.

One of 80 creatures in PingBlip, a free browser game: your creature hatches from live weather,
eats real sensor readings and falls asleep if you forget it. No sign-up.
Play free — link in profile (pingblip.com)
#pingblip #creaturecollector #virtualpet #browsergame #cozygames

music: Something Pinged (PingBlip original)
